subject: general
question: Which of the following parts is NOT associated with camshaft responsible for the opening and closing of engine valves?
solution:
The correct answer is __Connecting rod.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The camshaft is a critical component of the engine responsible for the opening and closing of valves__.
 
• __Rocker arms__, __tappets__, and __push rods__ are directly associated with the camshaft.
 
• __Connecting rod__ is not part of the valve mechanism; it connects the piston to the crankshaft.
 
• Hence, the connecting rod is NOT associated with the camshaft’s function of opening and closing valves.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Camshaft Functionality:**

 
 
• The camshaft rotates to operate rocker arms, which in turn push the valves open.
 
• Tappets and push rods are intermediary components in this process.
 
 
 
• **Connecting Rod:**
 
 
• It transmits the reciprocating motion of the piston to the rotary motion of the crankshaft.
 
• It plays no role in the valve mechanism or camshaft operation.
